seriesTitle: Self Made: Inspired by the Life of Madam C.J. Walker

episodes.title: The Fight of the Century
episodes.summary: Aspiring to be more than a washerwoman, Sarah grows determined to sell Addie's hair product. But when she's cruelly rebuffed, the gloves come off.

episodes.title: Bootstraps
episodes.summary: Sarah's dream of opening a factory hinges on securing the support of local Black businessmen — and an endorsement from the famous Booker T. Washington.

episodes.title: The Walker Girl
episodes.summary: Sarah's ambitious plans for expanding her empire take her to New York — and lead to betrayals personal and professional that threaten all she's built.

episodes.title: A Credit to the Race
episodes.summary: The combined blows of a health scare, worker issues and a tragedy that hits close to home push Sarah to take decisive action about her life and legacy.
